_comment: T-04 observation noise comparison | M3 × abrupt × 5 seeds × 1M steps
_purpose: Check framework generalisation across perturbation types. ObsNoisePerturbation isolates the JSD channel: D_k rises immediately (obs distribution shifts), reward degrades later. Compare Pr(timely) vs 2× gravity result (0.40). See planned_tests.md T-04 and tuning_journal.md T-04.
_why_M3_only: Consistent with T-03 — M3 × abrupt is the characterisation slice. Keeps T-04 to 5 runs.
_healthy_reward_note: T-03 revealed healthy_reward masking: T_soft may not fire if per-window reward stays above threshold due to episodic resets. ObsNoisePerturbation may have the same issue if noise causes frequent falls. If delta=0 for all seeds, this confirms masking is environment-level, not gravity-specific.
